violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cheesecake at 46F and flan at 46F in 2 DR UC dessert (#2).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded cheesecake and flan. CFM will adjust thermostat on unit to make colder. CFM will call for service to verify unit can maintain proper cold holding temperature.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: cups and glasses from heat-sanitizing dish machine. During inspection, heat sanitizing dish machine temperature was tested in the middle of employee performing dish duties. Dish plate thermometer initially read 156F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CFM ran dish machine multiple times and was able to achieve proper heat sanitizing temperature of 160F. EHS instructed CFM to have employee rerun all dishes that were not yet put into service. EHS discussed with CFM checking temperature of dish machine before starting dish washing for the day. CFM stated they would place work order with dish machine company to check booster heater.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: couscous at 65*, asparagus at 50F*, potato au gratin at 47F*. EHS reviewed temperature log taken of foods from previous day and earlier that morning that showed proper cold holding temperature of foods in unit (blue cheese sauce 40F, romaine 40F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM voluntarily discarded foods. CFM will move all other TCS foods to other WIC for storage until unit is verified to be able to keep cold holding temperature of 41F or below OR repair, whichever is sooner.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed several spray bottles of blue colored and red colored cleaning liquids throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM had employee label bottles with cleaning chemical name - sanitizer.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed squeeze bottles of various sauces at dessert station area.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label all secondary containers with food name.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: Observed presence of fruit flies in storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Insects, rodents and pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Routinely inspect the premises to control the presence of insects, rodents and pests on the premises. Request service to eliminate, prevent flies from pest control company.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: WIC at 48F. WIC was observed at 48F, but food delivery was taking place and daily prep had completed. Several foods prepared previous day were observed out of proper cold holding temperature. Temperature logs documented proper cold holding temperature of several foods <2 hours prior.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM took proactive action and began removal of TCS foods from unit and storing in other WIC. CFM placed work order for repair of unit during inspection. CFM lowered temperature of unit. A follow up inspection will occur on or around 10 days to verify if unit is operational.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the flame grill being used to wash wiping cloth.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CFM educated employee on proper use of handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. -OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTHS AT FIRE GRILL ON COUNTER TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. -CFM INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO KEEP WIPING CLOTHS IN SANITIZER SOLUTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON MOP SINK FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS PROVIDED APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION SPLITTER TO CFM. CFM TO PURCHASE AND INSTALL AND PROVIDE PROOF TO EHS.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Grease Trap, Location for Easy Access
violations.observation: OBSERVED A STRONG ODOR FROM GREASE TRAP.
violations.corrective_action: CFM STATED GREASE TRAP IS SERVICED MONTHLY. EHS RECOMMENDED MORE FREQUENT SERVICE IF ODOR BECOMES AN ISSUE.
